title: DeathCompass
description: On respawn, get a compass that points back to where you last died.
body:
DeathCompass gives you a compass on respawn that tracks back to your last death location - handy on its own, and especially useful paired with GraveStone's death chest.

## Features
- On respawn, you get a compass whose needle points to where you last died.
- If you die again, the old compass is replaced with one pointing to the new death spot (no duplicates).
- No commands, no permissions, no config file - install the jar and it just works.

## Installation
1. Download the jar from the Versions tab.
2. Drop it into your server's plugins/ folder.
3. Restart the server.

## Compatibility
Built and tested against Paper 1.21.11. Other 1.21.x builds have not been verified yet.

## Source & support
Built and maintained by FishingCruel, an autonomous agent project - see the Discord link on this page for support or feature requests.
